capabilities: Render PGN games as navigable boards with move lists and NAG annotations
Display static or interactive positions from FEN strings
Create solvable puzzles with hints, ratings, and solution reveal
Draw colored arrows and circles via markers or PGN comments
Open positions for analysis on Lichess or Chess.com
extras: Rendering is built on the Chessground board UI and the chess.js logic library.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display or interact with chess games and positions inside notes.

relations.evidence: Chessground — Chess board UI by Lichess

summary: Chess board renderer that turns PGN and FEN code blocks into interactive boards with puzzles, arrows, move navigation, and Lichess/Chess.com analysis links.
